verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say AI agents can interact with Drata to automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language, and a probe found an official MCP server documented in the help center. This is a first-party capability, but the evidence is a single marketing line plus the MCP pointer. Natural-language operation appears to depend on an external AI agent client, and no in-product assistant is shown. missing for 10: details of which operations are exposed to natural-language control, a native in-app natural-language interface, documentation depth beyond a one-line claim, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably.
